## Expert Lecture on “Technical Issues in the Design of Electric Vehicles”

News Date : 17 Oct 2025News ReportTheIndustry-Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC), in collaboration with theDepartment of Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), organized anExpert Lectureon17th October 2025as part of the IIPC activities.Dr. T. Ram Babu, Technology Head,L&T Technology Services, Hyderabad, delivered an insightful talk on the topic“Technical Issues in the Design of Electric Vehicles.”The session witnessed enthusiastic participation from students and faculty members across the Institute.In his address,Dr. Ram Babudiscussed various aspects of electric vehicle technology, includingcarbon emission and reduction potential, battery management systems, grid capacity challenges, and real-time industry case studies. He also highlighted theimpact of EVs on electricity demandand theemerging challenges in the electric mobility sector.Dr. G. Chandra Mohan Reddy, Principal, MGIT, encouraged students to explore thestate-of-the-art advancements in the electrical domainand contribute towards sustainable innovations.Dr. P. Ram Kishore Kumar Reddy, HoD, EEE, emphasized theimportance of understanding electric vehicle technologiesin the current industrial context.Dr. P. Chandra Sekhar, Convenor, IIPC, concluded the session with avote of thanks, appreciating the expert’s valuable insights and the active participation of the attendees.
